aboutGame.title: What is Japanese Ramen Simulator?
paragraphs: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a co-operative ramen shop management simulator developed by Wild Dog, released on Steam on 9 October 2026. It supports up to six players and covers preparing ingredients, cooking, serving food, looking after customers and cleaning up. Players create their own menu and design the shop.

You can play from a first-person or third-person camera, and the game lets you choose a view if you are prone to motion sickness. The store page does not publish a recipe list with exact ingredient quantities, prices, or a code system, so those details are not documented.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Japanese Ramen Simulator.

items.question: What is Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a co-operative ramen shop management simulator by Wild Dog, released on Steam on 9 October 2026. It supports up to six players and covers preparing ingredients, cooking, serving food, looking after customers and cleaning up. You create your own menu and design the shop.

items.question: Is Japanese Ramen Simulator hard for beginners?
items.answer: The game does not document difficulty or tutorials. Because it is a management simulator with up to six co-op players, a smooth shift usually depends on agreeing on roles and preparing ingredients before service.

items.question: How should I approach shop management in Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: The store page says you create your own menu and design the shop. The game does not publish an upgrade order or exact effects. A practical approach is to keep the shop layout and menu manageable for your team size and adjust after each shift.

items.question: Does Japanese Ramen Simulator have multiplayer?
items.answer: Yes. Japanese Ramen Simulator supports co-operative play for up to six players, with shared duties covering preparing ingredients, cooking, serving food, looking after customers and cleaning up.

items.question: How do I make money fast in Japanese Ramen Simulator?
items.answer: The store page does not publish prices, profit values, or a money-making system. Customer satisfaction and menu design are described features, so serving customers well and managing your shop are reasonable priorities, but exact figures are not documented.
